scope: 15 originally renamed national teams missing updated player rosters
source_description: Secondary transcription of FIFA World Cup 2026 squads with ESPN caps, captured in feuyeux/fifa-world-cup-2026 (as documented June 29 2026), derived for ISS26; verify against FIFA official for release.
source_notes: 26 to 22 chosen deterministically, higher national caps within game-role template; shirt number is tie-breaker; mismatched role positions flagged. Fictional names not allowed; ASCII and 10-byte game labels are non-official technical adaptations.
